verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API for running and managing models, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Python/JS libraries, so the core local workflows are exposed programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the desktop app's UI features, such as connecting Claude/ChatGPT Desktop via Apps or image generation. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage mapping, API evidence for app-only features (Apps connections, image generation), independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
OpenAPI specification for the Ollama HTTP API
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
